load_S2TDataConfig_from_yaml: create a S2TDataConfig instance by loading a YAML config file for speech-to-text data settings
get_features_or_waveform_from_audio: extract speech features from a .npy file or waveform from a .wav or .flac audio file
build_SpeechToTextDataset_from_tsv: build a SpeechToTextDataset from TSV manifest files using SpeechToTextDatasetCreator.from_tsv with a target dictionary
collate_audio_frames_with_collater: collate a list of audio frame tensors into a padded batch using the SpeechToTextDataset collater method
tokenize_text_with_pre_and_bpe: tokenize text using pre-tokenizer and BPE tokenizer via the SpeechToTextDataset tokenize_text method
